text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On a deserted island somewhere in the middle of the ocean… A ship drops off a dumbfounded Mejiro McQueen and quickly departs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What is the meaning of this? What could they possibly mean by "survive the night?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Do you know anything about this, Trainer?
choice_data_list: It's a project for the school newspaper.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her everything I know—that this is for an article called "Deserted Island: How Will the Pampered Survive?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I see. So they want a sheltered person like me to try and overcome the dangers of a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Then I will gladly accept the challenge! I won't be intimidated by the likes of this island!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Th-that said, it is a rather unsettling place. The thought of having to spend an entire night here is…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Aaaah! Is that a tiger?! A Bengal tiger?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I will not be bested!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: First things first. We must come up with a plan. I'll need your assistance, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What is the most important thing for surviving on a deserted island? Come, let's hear your answer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The most essential thing for survival is…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Food… You're saying that as long as we have nourishment, there's nothing to fear?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You're right. I'll never get home if all I do is sit here and dread the worst. It's time I start fending for myself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now then, Trainer, whenever you're ready.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Why, the food! You're going to bring us some, aren't you? I promise, I'll eat anything necessary to survive!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I won't be picky, be it fruit or seafood. Now, get to it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so Mejiro McQueen is able to secure food without so much as lifting a finger.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Endurance… I see. Without inexhaustible endurance, getting home safe is nothing but a fantasy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I suppose that means I will have to best that tiger in order to get stronger…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek! Is it still lurking in the bush?! I don't think I can do this after all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I don't think this endurance idea will work out, Trainer… I couldn't possibly—aaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The beast chases Mejiro McQueen around and around. I can't help but think that this may just be helping to improve her endurance.
